asin_fit_evidence引用了colors_visible，但该事实所列颜色（黑/粉/棕/深灰/浅蓝/白）不包含peach（桃色），rationale也承认'peach is not specifically evidenced'，证据支撑薄弱。
搜索词'cross flip flops'中cross存在歧义：交叉绑带设计 vs 十字架宗教符号，分类器选用了cross_strap但未在ambiguity_flags中标注该歧义。
品牌收割类搜索词'cushionaire flip flops'未在field_evidence中将品牌名'Cushionaire'作为辅助键(brand)保留，taxonomy明确要求品牌、价格、颜色、尺寸、材质、否定词应在field_evidence中作为辅助键。
asin_fit 为 match，但搜索词明确包含 rubber（橡胶），而商品事实仅声明 material_eva（EVA）。材质不匹配，应为 partial_match。
asin_fit 为 match，但搜索词明确要求 rubber flip flops，商品材质为 EVA 非橡胶。应为 partial_match。
asin_fit 为 partial_match，但搜索词 eva flip flops women 的三项需求（EVA材质、女性、夹脚拖）商品全部满足，asin_fit_evidence 也已引用 material_eva + title_womens_flip_flop + style_flip_flop。应为 match。
asin_fit 为 partial_match，但语义相同的搜索词 women's black flip-flops（4cbf93212c06b080）被判定为 match。两者均引用 title_womens_flip_flop + style_flip_flop + colors_visible，意图完全一致，应统一为 match。

product.page_evidence_policy: Only the fact IDs below may be cited as page_validated evidence. Alexa summaries, real-time price/delivery/inventory, review percentages, frequent-return notices, and medical-treatment claims are excluded.

facts.claim: The page title identifies a women's arch-support flip flop / thong sandal.
Outer material is Ethylene Vinyl Acetate (EVA).
The page states super lightweight and breathable.
The page states an upgraded soft toe post.
The page states ergonomic arch support and proper alignment for all-day comfort.
Seamless EVA construction is stated as easy to clean.
A deep textured lattice outsole is stated to provide grip and slip-resistant steps.
The visible size selector includes US sizes 6 through 11.
The visible color selectors include black, pink/mauve, brown, dark gray, light blue, and white.
